# Mini Racer

> A new track every day, one car, one clock. Mini Racer is a free top-down racing game that runs inside
> a Reddit post — nothing to install, no account needed to race.

Site: https://miniracer.club/
Community: https://www.reddit.com/r/MiniRacerGame/

## How it plays

You only steer — A and D, the arrow keys, or hold either side of the screen. The throttle never lets up,
so the whole game is your line. Walls scrape you; they don't end your lap. A lap runs well under a
minute.

## Modes

- Daily: everyone gets the same track, flipping at midnight UTC. Seven days stay open behind it, each
  keeping its own leaderboard.
- Campaign: 16 stages that never expire, ending on Half Life. Every stage pays a Bronze, Silver, Gold
  or Author medal, and those medals unlock the next one.
- Head to Head: someone posts a verified run frozen into a ghost, and you race it.

## Ghosts and times

Your best lap drives beside you every time you go again, and you can chase anyone on the leaderboard the
same way. The server re-drives your steering before a lap reaches the board and ranks it to the
millisecond, so bad and fake laps don't stick.

## The rest

Free, with no purchases. It runs in the Reddit post itself — desktop browser or the Reddit app on iOS
and Android — built on Devvit, Reddit's developer platform. Guests race everything; signing in to Reddit
carries your progress and lets you post times and challenges. 98 hand-built tracks. The 22 cars and 8
trails only change how you look.

## Pages

- [Home](https://miniracer.club/): play links for Daily and Campaign, plus the community.
- [About Mini Racer](https://miniracer.club/about.html): how it plays, the modes, ghosts, verified times.
